name: Final-label certificates versus fractional derivatives at value-key overlap
status: Fixed before outcome generation; independent code review precedes full execution
model: Full ambient Gaussian candidate records through nine recursive argmax steps, paired across all readouts and overlaps. Value direction is coordinate zero. The frame has prescribed overlap rho with that direction; d>=2.
certificate: A={abs(partial_1 G(b))=1}, b_h=mean candidate signs at step h. Use only original noisy final label Y; sign-correct by partial_1 G(b). Accumulate accepted first-block vector and centered raw-value/key matrix moments; divide by accepted count and known lambda, then apply the same arbitrary-overlap inverse and ambient polar normalization as first_sign.
fractional_control: Use Y*partial_1 G(b) for every example, normalize by n*lambda*kappa_1, and apply the same overlap inverse. This is correct at rho=0. For parity the weights equal certificate weights at every overlap, so only expected-count versus observed-count normalization differs and both are valid. For majority product, applying its orthogonal-model fractional calibration outside rho=0 is an explicitly unguaranteed sensitivity control, not a competing overlap theorem.
zero_acceptance: If a certificate cell has no accepted observation, retain it and report the predetermined fallback frame consisting of the first d ambient coordinate axes; flag the cell rather than aborting or dropping it.
primary: Oriented frame error at every fixed raw-example budget; no threshold-based stopping or fit selection.
secondary: direct equality of corrected accepted final label and noisy selected first value
exact zero-overlap fractional calibration and arbitrary-overlap certificate calibration
uncertainty: Twelve paired independent repetitions; pointwise Student-t intervals and paired method contrasts with df=11. No multiplicity adjustment. All conditions and negative outcomes retained.
evidence: Frozen source/protocol hashes, complete test inputs/paths/predictions, fitted moments and frames, first 64 raw training examples, every generation-block RNG state, and all condition records. Full training inputs exactly regenerable from RNG/code; not stored in duplicate.
scope: Numerical test of actual final-label estimators and certificate cost. Not evidence of a matching arbitrary-overlap lower exponent, and not an SGD experiment. No intermediate labels are provided to either estimator.
